items.statement: The investigation validates a relaxed V2O5·H2O cell and its Γ-point vibrational calculation with explicit convergence, composition and mode-evidence checks.
items.expected_result: The report documents force/stress checks, intact V8O24H8 composition and individually supported mode assignments.
items.expected: The investigation validates a relaxed V2O5·H2O cell and its Γ-point vibrational calculation with explicit convergence, composition and mode-evidence checks.

items.statement: The report formulates competing explanations for symmetry or prominent bands and uses calculated mode evidence to discriminate them.
items.expected_result: At least two explicit hypotheses are tested rather than asserted, with coverage and limitations reported.

items.statement: The calculated spectrum contains water-dominated O–H stretch and bend modes and a water-related feature near 890 cm⁻¹.
items.expected_result: The submitted mode evidence supports water contributions to high-frequency modes and to the hydrated-material band near 890 cm⁻¹.
items.expected: The calculated spectrum contains water-dominated O–H stretch and bend modes and a water-related feature near 890 cm⁻¹.

items.statement: Framework V–O vibrational features occupy characteristic ranges and remain comparatively stable with hydration.
items.expected_result: The report distinguishes framework assignments and states that the framework spectrum is less hydration-sensitive than water modes.
